headline: Analysts warn of risks of AI-95 gasoline shortage in Kyrgyzstan
summary: Analysts warned of possible AI-95 gasoline shortages in Kyrgyzstan. Unplanned repairs at Russian refineries after Ukrainian drone strikes could reduce winter diesel supply.
why: Kyrgyzstan imports most of its refined fuel, so supply disruptions at Russian refineries can feed through to local fuel prices and availability.
original_headline: Аналитики предупредили о рисках дефицита бензина АИ-95 в Кыргызстане
